---
name: Development Task
about: Track a planned development, refactoring, or engineering task
title: "[TASK]: "
labels: ["task"]
assignees: ""
---

## 📌 Task Title
A concise summary of the engineering task.

## 📝 Task Description
Detailed explanation of what needs to be implemented, configured, or updated.

## 🏢 Responsible Module & Owner
- **Module:** [e.g., Frontend / Backend / AI-Service / Database / Documentation]
- **Target Role/Domain:** [e.g., Check-in, RFQ, Authentication, AI Assistant, etc.]

## 🎯 Expected Outcome
What concrete deliverables will be produced when this task is marked as done?

## 🚦 Priority
- [ ] Low (Cosmetic, non-blocking documentation)
- [ ] Medium (Standard sprint task)
- [ ] High (Core functionality required for upcoming milestone)
- [ ] Critical (Blocking other developers or milestone delivery)

## 🔗 Dependencies & Blockers
List any tasks or PRs that must be resolved before this work can begin:
- Depends on: #...
- Blocks: #...

## 📋 Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Implementation completed according to Phase 1 specifications
- [ ] Code adheres to team quality standards and type definitions
- [ ] Relevant documentation or API contracts updated
- [ ] Local tests verified
